name: Reducto
description: AI document-processing platform: parse, extract, split, classify and edit documents via API.
access_notes: Create a free account at studio.reducto.ai, then generate an API key from the API Keys page in Studio; all roles can create keys. Usage is credit-billed via Studio billing.
mcp_notes: Vendor-hosted MCP at https://mcp.reducto.ai/mcp (Bearer auth) plus a local server via `uvx mcp-server-reducto`, documented at docs.reducto.ai/mcp-server. No Composio toolkit found (docs.composio.dev/toolkits/reducto returns 404).
uncertainty_notes: Exact free-tier credit allotment not verified from a pricing page; docs confirm a free account and immediate self-serve API key creation. Breadth is document-processing focused (parse/extract/split/classify/edit + jobs/upload), so rated medium rather than broad.

evidence.note: Base URL platform.reducto.ai, 'Auth: Authorization: Bearer $REDUCTO_API_KEY', 'Create a free account at studio.reducto.ai' then create an API key
Studio sidebar provides Usage, API Keys, Webhooks, Billing; 'Configure webhooks for async job notifications'; all roles can create API keys
Official vendor MCP server page: hosted https://mcp.reducto.ai/mcp with Bearer header, or local uvx mcp-server-reducto
Developer page: full OpenAPI spec, REST endpoints for parse/extract/split/classify, SDKs for Python/Node/Go
